## Intended behavior

- [ ] Acceptance criteria were frozen before implementation.
- [ ] Every new interface exists in the repository or version-matched primary documentation.

## Evidence

- Inspected:
- Executed:

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No benchmark label or threshold was changed to fit the implementation.
- [ ] No query, answer, deterministic query hash, precise location, secret, or human-review content was added to telemetry.
- [ ] Provider fallback and ZDR behavior remain fail-closed.

## Review

- [ ] Generated OpenAPI and frontend types are synchronized.
- [ ] Targeted tests pass.
- [ ] `make verify` passes, or missing evidence is stated explicitly.
- [ ] Critical changes have named human review.
